run_f_gold: run f_gold to check if an array of n elements contains consecutive integers
test_f_gold: test f_gold against f_filled using the provided parameter sets in main
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to use a set-based approach instead of a visited array
summarize_f_gold: summarize how f_gold checks consecutive elements by comparing max minus min plus one to n
review_f_gold: review f_gold for edge cases like negative numbers, duplicates, and single-element arrays
